summary: The edition has 84 complete guides and 7 screened discoveries. It completes 20 earlier pending guides and details 5 substantive release updates. Velorn v0.4.3 supplies reference imagery for every named cast member in a shot. Phosphene documents a local named-voice route for two authorized characters. Local photo culling, animation inbetweens and editing from recorded dialogue are covered alongside less common studio workflows. OpenSloper exposes editable costume patterns to a model client, dScribe drafts alt text for human review, and Sound2Hap explores turning short environmental sounds into tactile cues. Code grants were read in full. Models, services, creative inputs and hardware or software hosts have separate requirements. This edition is based on source review and published documentation. No discovered app was installed or run. The expanded plan covered 56 fields, 345/345 repository-query attempts and 21 model tasks. The repository lane recorded 345 successful, 0 partial and 0 failed queries, with 99 bounded. The model lane recorded 0 failed tasks. Metadata from 480 saved repository pages included 19,283 numeric identities. The complete retained backlog spans 124,309 candidates, including pilot history and 1,075 previously screened guides still pending before this edition. Creative relevance and the complete software grant were checked before including any discovery. Unreviewed and excluded records stay in local research. Live primary research yielded 217 complete usable responses from 252 distinct URL attempts, including a non-GitHub source in each of 56 fields. 0 captures reached the size bound and 35 other sources were inaccessible or unusable. The ecosystem checks cover all 8 configured groups and record available findings and gaps. Evidence labels in this edition are 0 Recommended, 0 Ready to try, 85 Quality unverified, 6 Experimental. Independent use remains unverified for 88 entries. The creative result check remains unverified for 90, and model, service or cost requirements remain unverified for 91. Repository searches returned no saved rows for Embodied and tactile interactive art, Multiband art and heritage imaging. Primary web research for these fields is included in the coverage notes. 21 model tasks reached the configured response limit of 50 rows. A model record remains a discovery lead until code and use are verified. The separate watchlist made 68 unsuccessful repository checks. Collection logged 8 enrichment failures. Credential-shaped material in unsealed captures was removed before sealing. The affected source origins and before-and-after hashes remain in private evidence.
